verdict.rationale: The RTX 5090 comes with a software ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, NVIDIA app, developer portal), so an official MCP server for agent connection is a plausible axis. Nothing in the evidence documents one. The llms.txt probe and the CUDA/DLSS docs are adjacent agent-readability or developer material, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
